relations.subject: capella:organization
relations.evidence: To add users to your organization, you must have the [Organization Owner](organization-user-roles.md#organization-role-organization-owner) role.

relations.subject: capella:organization
relations.evidence: To change a user's organization role, you must have the [Organization Owner](organization-user-roles.md#organization-role-organization-owner) organization role.

relations.subject: capella-role:organization-owner
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: minted - impliesRole. Captures automatic role-implication (holding one role confers another everywhere in scope) - structurally distinct from grantsRole/assignsRole (an explicit admin action) and from groupMembersInheritRole (group-membership-driven). Inverse direction confirmed by the same page on removal.
relations.evidence: If you remove the Organization Owner role from a user, they also lose the [Project Owner](../projects/project-roles.md#project-owner-role) role for all projects in their organization. They keep their other project roles.

relations.subject: auth:sso
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (autoRegistersUser) - originally minted for Sync Gateway auth providers creating a user identity on first successful authentication without an explicit CREATE USER-equivalent step; this Capella SSO behavior is the same shape
relations.evidence: Users with SSO do not need an invitation and can sign in using the organization's realm name.

relations.subject: capella:organization
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (requiresCapellaRole) - here a cardinality floor (organization must always retain a holder) rather than a gate on a single action
relations.evidence: An organization must have at least one user with the [Organization Owner](organization-user-roles.md#organization-role-organization-owner) role at all times.

relations.subject: auth:realm
relations.evidence: For more information, see [Sign in to Capella with SSO](ui-auth/sign-in-with-sso.md).

notable_absence.finding: This page describes SSO user removal via the realm/Capella UI in detail but never repeats the paid-support-plan gate on SSO itself (that gate appears on ui-auth/capella-ui-auth.md and add-sso-auth.md) - consistent with it being a one-time enablement gate rather than a per-action one.

cross_component_finding: Organization Owner is the single load-bearing role in this file: it gates every mutating action on organization users (invite, change role, remove) and is the only role with a hard floor-of-one cardinality constraint. The impliesRole finding (Organization Owner -> Project Owner, bidirectionally enforced on grant and removal) is the clearest evidence so far that capella-role:* is a small hierarchy, not a flat set of three independent roles.
